note: From the 2026-08-05 register-first pass on the MASAF national register (CC BY 4.0). The register holds 36 entries for the comune of Lucca, 20 of them inside the walled city; six were published. Leads failed only our evidence bar, the count, or the cluster; blocked can never ship as they stand. The register total is a count of designated entries, not of trees that exist.

leads.name: The Corsican pine of the Orto Botanico
leads.why: Register 29/E715/LU/09, 282 cm girth and 30.5 m, planted in 1822 in the same season as the Cedar of Lebanon, so it ties for oldest tree in the garden. Cut on the count and on the cluster balance, not on evidence: four of the six published trees would then sit inside one garden. The strongest single candidate for a seventh entry.

leads.name: The magnolia of Via dell'Orto Botanico
leads.why: Register 01/E715/LU/09, 323 cm girth and 24 m, standing on the street just outside the botanical garden and squarely on the published walk. A second registered Magnolia grandiflora inside the garden (28/E715/LU/09, 425 cm, dated 1830 by LuccaInDiretta) is the bigger and better documented of the two. Both cut on the count; the garden one is the better lead.

leads.name: The plane of Via del Fosso
leads.why: Register 02/E715/LU/09, 360 cm girth and 30 m, on the canal street between the botanical garden and Villa Bottini, so it sits on the walk without lengthening it. Cut on evidence: no source names this individual tree, only the register, and no source dates it.

leads.name: [RESOLVED 2026-08-23, delivered as luc_011] The plane of Porta San Donato
leads.why: RESOLVED 2026-08-23: register entry 05/E715/LU/09 (488 cm girth, 30 m) delivered to data/research/lucca-verified.json as luc_011, flagged (single register source only; no second source found this pass). See verify_notes on luc_011 for the full record.

leads.name: The false camphor of Via Barsanti e Matteucci
leads.why: Register 11/E715/LU/09, 384 cm girth and 24 m, in the San Marco district north of the walls, about 900 m outside the published cluster. A second false camphor stands inside the botanical garden (37/E715/LU/09, planted 1888 per LuccaInDiretta, no girth recorded). Cut on cluster and on count.

leads.name: [RESOLVED 2026-08-23, delivered as luc_012 and luc_013] The bald cypress twins and the Balearic box of the Orto Botanico
leads.why: RESOLVED 2026-08-23: the two bald cypresses (32/ and 33/E715/LU/09, 15 m apart) folded into one entry, delivered as luc_012. The Balearic box (36/E715/LU/09) delivered separately as luc_013, since it is a different species and individual with its own rarity case. Both flagged, single register source only; the garden's own 'Testimoni silenziosi' page and a LuccaInDiretta piece on the garden's 52 monumental trees exist but returned no usable body text to a plain curl fetch this pass (JS-rendered). See verify_notes on luc_012/luc_013.

leads.name: [RESOLVED 2026-08-23, delivered as luc_014] The silver lime and the fastigiate yew of the Orto Botanico
leads.species: Tilia tomentosa and Taxus baccata var. fastigiata
leads.why: RESOLVED 2026-08-23: delivered as luc_014, one combined entry for both specimens (they stand about 60 m apart, so location_precision is set approximate rather than confirmed). Flagged: single register source independently re-fetched this pass; the 1900 planting date for the lime carried over from an earlier pass's LuccaInDiretta citation, not independently re-verified this pass (the outlet's page returned no usable body text to a plain curl fetch). See verify_notes on luc_014.

leads.name: The Lebanon cedar and camphor tree of San Pancrazio
leads.species: Cedrus atlantica, Cinnamomum camphora, Ginkgo biloba and others
leads.why: BLOCKED 2026-08-23 (depth pass): six registered trees at one address (Via di Matraia 269, San Pancrazio), 7 km north of the walls, which strongly suggests a single private villa park rather than public ground, and no source found this pass states the grounds are open to visitors. Per hard rule 10, when access cannot be stated honestly the tree waits rather than ships. Also sits beyond Lucca's roughly-30-minute public-transport day-trip boundary as far as this pass could establish (no direct bus route timed this pass). Needs both an access source and a transit check before it could be reconsidered; not pursued further this pass.

blocked.name: The plane trees of Piazza Santa Maria
blocked.why: Not a collectible point. The register lists it as an insieme omogeneo, a homogeneous group of three planes on a square, with no girth or height for any individual, and there is no one tree to stand at. The Torre Guinigi oaks pass the same test only because the ensemble itself is the destination and there is exactly one place to stand.

blocked.name: The cypresses of Villa Altieri, Gattaiola
blocked.why: An avenue. The register lists it as an insieme omogeneo along Via di Villa Altieri with no individual measurements, and an avenue is not a collectible point.

blocked.name: The trees of the Lucca walls as a planting
blocked.species: Platanus x acerifolia, Aesculus, Tilia, Quercus rubra, Ulmus, Celtis and others
blocked.why: Roughly 700 planes plus thousands of other trees around a 4.2 km circuit, described tree species by tree species in the city's own walls itinerary. It is a park, not an entry. Only the three individuals the national register singles out on the walls can be published, one of which is on this page.

blocked.name: The camellia of Massa Pisana
blocked.why: Located on Via del Colletto in Massa Pisana with no girth recorded and no indication of public access; a registered camellia of this kind is almost always in a private villa garden. Hard rule 10: not published unless a source confirms visitors are welcome.

blocked.name: The Deodar cedar of Vinchiana
blocked.why: Register 44/E715/LU/09, 530 cm and 30 m, on the Via del Brennero 9 km north of the city. No source establishes public access and no independent source mentions the tree at all. Blocked pending access, not rejected on quality.

blocked.name: The second redwood of the Orto Botanico
blocked.why: BLOCKED 2026-08-23 (depth pass): confirmed by reading the published Lucca city file, luc_002's own story already names this tree explicitly ('A second registered redwood stands forty metres away, a little smaller'). It reads as part of the same nineteenth-century planting as the published redwood rather than a separate destination, so it does not get its own id or pin; it is depth for the existing entry, not a new collectible point. Leave it here as a record rather than re-researching it.

blocked.name: The Atlas cedar of Villa Bottini's neighbours, and the rest of the Garden of the Righteous
blocked.species: Calocedrus decurrens and Platanus x acerifolia
blocked.why: BLOCKED 2026-08-23 (depth pass), confirming the earlier pass's own read: an incense cedar and a plane dedicated on 25 April 2021 next to the already-published Cedar of the Righteous (luc_006). Neither is in the national register, neither has a published girth or height, and at five years old neither is genuinely old, visually spectacular or (beyond the shared memorial dedication already covered by luc_006) independently historically significant enough to carry its own entry. Fails the evidence bar as a standalone tree; the memorial story belongs to luc_006, not to a new id. Not pursued further.

open_questions: The comune of Lucca has 36 register entries against 52 monumental trees reported in a 2014-era municipal census by quinewslucca.it. Either the municipality counts individuals where the register counts sheets, or the two lists differ. Reconcile before any page quotes a Lucca total.

The Torre Guinigi oaks have no date anywhere. The city's cultural office runs the tower and might know when the current seven were planted; one email or one fetch of a municipal document could turn a flagged entry into a dated one.
The Orto Botanico's own site does not publish an admission price in a place we could fetch, so the access field says paid entry without a figure. Worth pinning down.
